name: Modron Hierarch

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.details: Enemies can’t gain combat advantage by flanking the hierarch.

traits.name: Implacable
traits.details: An enemy cannot enter the hierarch’s space by any means.

effect.description: The hierarch can slide the target 1 square.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one, two, or three creatures in the burst

hit.description: force damage, and the hierarch slides the target up to 3 squares.

miss.description: The hierarch can slide the target 1 square.

hit.description: force damage, and the target is restrained and takes ongoing 5 force damage (save ends both).

miss.description: Half damage, and ongoing 5 force damage (save ends).

powers.name: Multifaceted Reflection
powers.trigger: An enemy within 10 squares of the hierarch pushes, pulls, or slides it.

hit.description: The hierarch ignores the forced movement and slides the target up to a number of squares equal to the triggering forced movement.

powers.name: From One Come Many
powers.trigger: The hierarch drops to 0 hit points.

effect.description: The hierarch is destroyed, and either two duodrones or two quadrones appear in the hierarch’s space or in unoccupied squares adjacent to it. Each duodrone or quadrone starts with hit points equal to its own bloodied value. These modrons act on the hierarch’s initiative and are worth no experience points.
